here's a rough wireframe I drew up for our checkout page, can you turn it into a working html page?

```
Logo   Cart   Account     [ Checkout ]
────────────────────────────────────────

┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Order Summary                       │
├─────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                     │
│ [Enter promo code...    ] [ Apply ] │
│                                     │
│ ☑ Same as billing address           │
│                                     │
│          [ Place Order ]            │
│                                     │
└─────────────────────────────────────┘
```

sketch a wireframe for a SaaS pricing page — three tiers (Starter, Pro, Enterprise) side by side, each in a card with a feature list, price, and CTA button at the bottom. Enterprise should have a 'Contact Sales' button instead of a price.

I have this mockdown wireframe from mockdown.design that a designer sent me, need to convert it to a React component using shadcn/ui:

```
[ Active ]  Tab 2  Tab 3
─────────────────────────

[/ Filter...        ]

┌────────┬────────┬────────┐
│ Name   │ Status │ Action │
├────────┼────────┼────────┤
│        │        │        │
│        │        │        │
└────────┴────────┴────────┘
```
can you make a quick wireframe for a mobile app login screen? needs email, password, a 'forgot password' link, sign in button, and social login options at the bottom (google, apple)

I need a wireframe for our internal admin dashboard — should have a left sidebar with nav items (Dashboard, Users, Reports, Settings), a top header with search and user avatar, and the main area shows a stats overview with 4 metric cards at the top and a data table below

heres what the designer wants for the user profile settings, can you wireframe this out?

they want a split panel — left side has avatar upload, name field, and email field. right side has notification preferences with toggles for email notifications, push notifications, and weekly digest. save button at the bottom spans full width.

mockup for a blog post page — title at top, author info with avatar, published date, then the article body area (just use lorem ipsum placeholder), and at the bottom a comments section with a text area and submit button

I need to create a REST API endpoint for user registration. Should accept email, password, and name fields, validate them, hash the password with bcrypt, store in postgres, and return a JWT token. Using Express.js with TypeScript.

can you help me debug this CSS grid layout? the sidebar is supposed to be 250px fixed width but it keeps collapsing on mobile. here's my current code:

```css
.layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 250px 1fr; }
```
write a python script that reads a CSV file with columns name, email, department and generates an org chart as a mermaid diagram showing the reporting hierarchy

I have this table in my markdown README and the columns aren't aligned properly, can you fix the formatting?

| Package | Version | Status |
|---|---|---|
| react | 18.2.0 | stable |
| next | 14.1.0 | stable |

create an excalidraw diagram showing the data flow between our microservices — API Gateway connects to Auth Service, User Service, and Order Service. Order Service talks to Payment Service and Inventory Service.
I need to add a loading spinner component to my React app. Should show a centered spinner with optional message text below it. Use CSS animations, no external dependencies.
help me set up a CI/CD pipeline for my .NET app using GitHub Actions. needs to build, run tests, and deploy to Azure App Service on push to main
can you draw me a box around this text in my terminal output using ANSI escape codes? I want it to look nice with double-line borders for the header row. working in python.
I want to create a Figma-like design system with color tokens, typography scale, and spacing variables. Can you set up the CSS custom properties and document them?
write a blazor component for a data grid that supports sorting, filtering, and pagination. should work with any IQueryable data source and render a table with column headers
